description: This file defines a handler class for OpenAI Text-to-Speech requests with guardrail support. It processes input text to apply guardrails before sending requests and bypasses guardrail processing for output audio data.

classes.name: OpenAITextToSpeechHandler
classes.description: Handler class for processing OpenAI text-to-speech requests with guardrails, extending BaseTranslation.

methods.name: Any process_input_messages( self, data: dict, guardrail_to_apply: "CustomGuardrail", litellm_logging_obj: Optional[Any] = None, )
methods.description: Applies guardrails to the input text parameter of the request data before sending.

methods.name: Any process_output_response( self, response: "HttpxBinaryResponseContent", guardrail_to_apply: "CustomGuardrail", litellm_logging_obj: Optional[Any] = None, user_api_key_dict: Optional[Any] = None, )
methods.description: Returns the response unchanged, as output guardrails are not applicable for binary audio data.

ctags.name: process_input_messages
ctags.signature: ( self, data: dict, guardrail_to_apply: "CustomGuardrail", litellm_logging_obj: Optional[Any] = None, )

ctags.name: process_output_response
ctags.signature: ( self, response: "HttpxBinaryResponseContent", guardrail_to_apply: "CustomGuardrail", litellm_logging_obj: Optional[Any] = None, user_api_key_dict: Optional[Any] = None, )
